title: Design: a tier row's menu, with Delete red or grayed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses that has priced nothing.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses that open work orders keep (a customer on it has an open work order).
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open tier A's three-dot menu.
  3. Press Esc.
  4. Open tier B's three-dot menu.
  5. Point at Delete.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • The menu lists Audit Log, Archive and Delete, with Delete in red, as in picture 2.7.

Step 3:

  • The menu closes; the list shows.

Step 4:

  • The menu lists Audit Log, Archive and a grayed Delete, as in picture 2.8.

Step 5:

  • A dark gray tooltip shows below Delete with the reason, as in picture 2.8.
